title: (RHEA-2020:1221) new packages: fuse3
portal_summary: New fuse3 packages are now available for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux Server|7|x86_64
Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux for IBM z Systems|7|s390x
Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux for Power, little endian|7|ppc64le
Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux Workstation|7|x86_64
Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux Desktop|7|x86_64
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
The fuse3 packages contain version 3 of the File System in Userspace (FUSE) tools to mount a FUSE file system. With FUSE, it is possible to implement a fully functional file system in a user-space program.

This enhancement update adds the fuse3 packages to Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7 Extras. (BZ#1750746)

All users who require fuse3 are advised to install these new packages.
